mapper.select: SELECT LAST_SENT_AT AS lastSentAt, LOCKED_UNTIL AS lockedUntil FROM EMAIL_VERIFICATION WHERE EMAIL_HASH = #{emailHash} AND VERIFY_TYPE = #{type} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMAIL_VERIFICATION ( EMAIL_HASH, VERIFY_TYPE, CODE_HASH, EXPIRES_AT, ATTEMPTS, LOCKED_UNTIL, LAST_SENT_AT, USED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{emailHash}, #{type}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, 0, NULL, #{now}, NULL, #{now}, #{now} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CODE_HASH = VALUES(CODE_HASH), EXPIRES_AT = VALUES(EXPIRES_AT), ATTEMPTS = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL= NULL, LAST_SENT_AT= VALUES(LAST_SENT_AT), USED_AT = NULL, UPDATED_AT = VALUES(UPDATED_AT)
